text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*... *pant*.
How was my time?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: —Looks like fatigue is starting to catch up with you. Shall we take a break?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
I don't wanna do anything...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hm, huh... Messiah-san?
What time do you think it is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...
...*sigh*, alright.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um... Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Yes, how may I help you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Uh, um. Excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "...Do you always train this late into the night?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Most days... let's see.
It's usually around this amount.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Every day, you say? Hahaha...
That's truly impressive, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing of the sort, not in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Little by little... step by step... through hard work,
I must bridge the gap between myself
and the others of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"A difference, you say?
So even for you, Messiah-san... it's like that."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
...Even so, we have to do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Simply, single-mindedly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Watching Messiah-san made me realize how much further I still have to go."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for giving me courage. It was a wonderful run."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Was I... able to do anything for them?
choice_data_list: You watched over Messiah for me.
You watched over Messiah for me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...?
—Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um... would you like to go train?
I really feel like running right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, no. That's not the case at all.
It's just the usual for me.
